info.name: Oyla Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the education platform: Users (Student/Teacher/Coach), Courses, Modules, Lessons, Steps, Resources, Class Sessions, Groups, Step Completions, Feedbacks, and Meetups.

Set the `base_url` collection variable to your running server (default http://127.0.0.1:8000). Run 'Login' or any 'Signup' request first — it automatically saves the returned token into the `token` collection variable, which every other request uses via a Token auth header.

Safety: every DELETE uses run_… variables that exist only during a Runner run, so deletes can't touch real data.

exec: // Safety: we never change the admin's real password.
// If you're logged in as a user you signed up, change that user's password;
// otherwise create a throw-away demo student and change its password.
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/auth/login/', method: 'POST', header: H(),
body: json({ username: 'admin3', password: pm.variables.get('admin_password') }) }, (e1, adm) => {
if (e1 || adm.code !== 200) { console.log('admin login failed'); return; }
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/students/', method: 'POST', header: H({ Authorization: 'Token ' + at }),
body: json({ username: name, password: 'DemoPass123!', first_name: 'Demo', last_name: 'Password', email: name + '@example.com' }) }, (e2) => {
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/auth/login/', method: 'POST', header: H(),
body: json({ username: name, password: 'DemoPass123!' }) }, (e3, st) => {
if (!e3 && st.code === 200) { pm.collectionVariables.set('token', st.json().token); pm.variables.set('auth_token', 'Token ' + st.json().token); }
